dedupe_keys.name: quantification of collapse margin for steel high rises

description: Quantification of Collapse Margin for Steel High-rises is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Masayoshi Nakashima, Kyoto University (kyoto-u.ac.jp). This research project aims to evaluate the seismic behavior of steel high-rises, which hold many company headquarters as tenants, subjected to long-period ground motion and near-fault earthquakes. Component tests, a large-scale shaking table test (E-Defense test), and sophisticated numerical simulations are conducted to reveal the margin to collpase in a steel high-rise. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/DS2T375. Keywords: Shaking table, steel, collapse. Published 2018-01-04. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the DesignSafe listing (publication licences offered are CC BY 4.0, ODC-By, CC0 and GPL; project page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
